name: nft-drop-peer-under-accept-chain
description: same drop rule as nft-drop-peer, appended below a jump that already accepts
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f allow
nft add rule inet f allow ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add rule inet f out jump allow

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
